'''2007 Maryland State Championship James Booker LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Booker
* '''Deck name:''' Jesus Christ, its alien, Get the car!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
